title: Yapi: Farmer's Choice
description: A Farmer’s Delight addon that solves frustrating RNG in modpacks and gives full control over cutting results — a clean upgrade that feels like it always belonged in the mod.
body: ## YAPI: Choice Chopper > A natural extension of Farmer’s Delight that solves modpack issues while feeling like part of the original mod. Farmer’s Delight cutting system works great on its own. However, in modpacks, recipes are often overridden, causing some outputs to become inaccessible or effectively hidden behind randomness. Choice Chopper solves this by restoring access to all possible results, while preserving the original balance and design of the mod. It doesn’t replace the system. It completes it.   ### What this mod does Adds a single block that allows you to: * cycle through all available results for a given input item * manually select the desired output No more lost options or hidden recipes. undefined ### Design philosophy This mod is designed as a clean, gameplay-friendly solution to modpack limitations. It doesn’t overcomplicate the system or introduce unnecessary mechanics, but instead enhances it in a way that feels like it always belonged in Farmer’s Delight. Automation is also supported, making the block useful both for manual play and technical setups.   ### Features * Access all valid cutting results * Full control over outputs * Seamless Farmer’s Delight integration * Fortune enchantment support * Automation support (input/output sides) * Animations, particles, and sound feedback ### Requirements * Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 * Farmer’s Delight * GeckoLib undefined ### Permissions You are allowed to: * include this mod in modpacks You are NOT allowed to: * reupload this mod * redistribute modified versions * use assets or code without permission All rights reserved. ## Community Follow the development of the mod, share ideas, and stay updated here: **YouTube:** [https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs](https://www.youtube.com/@YAPILabs) **Discord:** [https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz](https://discord.gg/KYGyy9jFCz)   ### Author ### Y221
